findings.title: The actual member launch path omits the required managed binding protocol dependency

evidence.observation: The described actual path proceeds from Runtime9 activation to ReviewMemberGrant, snapshot, Session/invocation/Worker registration and native input. It defines a new private launch identity, but does not require the genuine allocated prepared-owner/input pair or the normal/late/deferred factual binding producer.

Currency and delivery explicitly await Runtime9 and its projection hook. They do not specify the original dispatch-marker Workflow body/full scoped lock frame or the private permitted-successor protocol needed when member Session binding, live waits and sibling projections interact with SourceRecovery and Driver.

Review member execution requires actual binding composition. The mandatory original frame, genuine allocation/prepared/admitted/consumed protocol, factual writer restrictions and original-authority-derived Source/Driver successor cannot be supplied by Unit/Invocation DTOs or a terminal receipt.

Current ordinary managed start return writes Session/execution into the attempt, refreshes current owners and persists the ordinary Workflow transition; it is not the approved factual binding producer.

Existing Native registration creates Session/Invocation from ExecutionAuthority and NativeSeed. It does not supply the missing immutable full marker/private phase owner and preparation/consumption pair merely by being used by a new member branch.

Existing source bookkeeping before_write/after_write recaptures resulting pins under the old typed transition plan. The new binding requirements expressly require a permitted private successor instead of a generic after_write refresh at the binding boundary.

findings.causal_trigger: After Runtime9 becomes available, an implementer can follow the complete path and delivery list as written and enable member native execution with the new ReviewMemberGrant plus Session/Invocation/Worker rows, without composing the required original-marker owner/input protocol. A normal or lost/deferred start return, or a sibling/live-quota projection change during that interval, then has no defined factual binding/current-successor consumer contract. Either ordinary refresh behavior is reused, or legitimate member progress conflicts with the untouched exact Source/Driver claims.
findings.actual_guard_condition: Before any managed member marker/preparation/helper/native effect, availability must be derived from the actual Binding10 producer composition. Each member must carry the genuine private original marker, allocated prepared-owner/input pair and its actual consumption/settlement correlation. Session binding and legitimate wait/closure projections must consume the exact permitted successor anchored at original authority, never reconstruct it from current Unit/Worker/Session DTOs or silently refresh Source/Driver pins.
findings.requested_change: Add Binding10 as an explicit pending prerequisite of the member actual path and delivery, and map the member marker/allocation/prepared-input/normal-return/late/deferred binding and native live-wait branches to its actual private producer and sole factual writer. Specify how Round/Worker bindings adapt the complete original frame and how sibling projections compose the SourceRecovery7/Runtime9 successor ports. Until the joint design/source consumer composition is fixed, keep Review member readiness held. Do not replace the approved semantic-versus-projection distinction; define its authorized integration.
findings.acceptance_gap: Require causal controls for genuine prepared pre-input normal binding, consumed successful late binding, refusal of the same NotDispatched pair on the late path, lost/dropped start delivery, original full-lock/body drift, sibling projection updates and all generic/bypass writers through the real member adapter/Driver consumers.

findings.title: The member preparation sequence does not consume the whole-cohort capacity authority before effects

evidence.observation: The numbered actual path registers Round/Workers, then inserts a Unit and issues ReviewMemberGrant, then performs snapshot preparation. It states schedule/cohort authority explicitly at native input, but reserve_review_member has no explicit scheduling/cohort grant prerequisite.

Concurrent-only is specified as whole-cohort capacity or zero and no partial native inputs. This does not state that a queued zero-capacity cohort issues no member preparation grants or starts no snapshot/version helpers.

Approved reserve_review_member consumes the quota/resource scheduling grant. Actual ReviewCohortAdmission must precede member preparation/native effects; only the successful whole-cohort reservation issues linked private member grants.
A wholly unadmitted queued Set owns no round worktree lock, and missing genuine all-or-nothing admission refuses before member preparation/native effects.

findings.causal_trigger: A genuine concurrent-only cohort producer exists, but current global/project/provider capacity cannot fit the entire roster. Following the listed preparation sequence, reserve_review_member can still mint a grant and materialize snapshots/helpers before the later native input capacity check. Zero partial inputs is then preserved while the approved before-preparation boundary and wholly-unadmitted Set lock invariant are violated.
findings.actual_guard_condition: For CONCURRENT_ONLY, reserve_review_member must validate and consume a successful current whole-roster ReviewCohortAdmission before any member Unit preparation grant, review worktree lock, materialization or helper/native effect. A queued or failed all-or-nothing claim issues zero linked grants. Resource admission mutual exclusion and the SQL port/path leases are not substitutes for the native scheduling permits.
findings.requested_change: Insert the actual cohort admission producer before member reservation/preparation in section 2, and add its exact private grant/current cohort pins to reserve_review_member and the helper/native authority checks. State the zero-capacity queued behavior explicitly, including no preparation grants/effects or round worktree lock. Preserve serialized-capable per-member admission and original-window fencing.
findings.acceptance_gap: Add actual negative controls that saturate one required capacity bucket with a fully registered valid cohort/profile, invoke member preparation, and assert zero grants/Units, no new review worktree lock, no snapshot/version helper intents and no native inputs. Restore capacity to demonstrate the genuine whole-cohort positive path and compiled guard mutation at reserve_review_member.
